sobreNosotros.configuracionDescripcion: Our vision, our mission, and where the brand's name comes from.

nombre.p1: Llankia comes from llank'ay, a Quechua word that means to work. In the Andean world, work was never just a way to make a living: it's persistence, pride, and community.
nombre.p2: Llank'ay is part of a way of understanding life alongside yachay (to know) and munay (to want): to know, to want, and to work. We chose that origin because it sums up what we want you to feel when using the app: your work matters, and your hours deserve to be recorded.

queEs.titulo: What Llankia is, and how it relates to your hours
queEs.p1: Llankia is an app for keeping track of your worked hours and overtime, without complicated spreadsheets or notebooks that get lost.
queEs.p2: You take a photo of your schedule or type it in, and Llankia turns it into something clear: how many hours you worked this week, how many were overtime, and what they add up to. Your shifts even sync with your calendar, so you never forget what time you start.

simbolo.p1: Llankia's logo is a clock that reads like a checkmark. The circle represents time; the hands, meeting at the center, draw the sign of done, recorded, confirmed.
simbolo.frase: A clock that closes into a checkmark: time recorded, week resolved.

mision.texto: To give every worker control and clarity over their own time. We believe knowing exactly how many hours you worked shouldn't be a privilege or a chore. That's why we make recording them take seconds, and understanding them instant.

vision.texto: To be the trusted app for shift workers across Latin America: the place where every hour is clearly recorded, and where teams and companies find a fair, transparent way to organize working time.

items.texto: Every screen answers a simple question: how much did I work, and how much am I owed? No fine print.
The app adapts to your schedule, not the other way around. If your shifts change every week, Llankia changes with you.
Your hours, your photos, and your information belong to you. We don't sell or share them.
Llankia is built in Lima, thinking about how work actually happens in the region: rotating shifts, paper schedules, and WhatsApp groups.
If a feature doesn't make life easier for someone coming home tired from their shift, it doesn't ship.

historia.p1: Llankia started from a personal problem. Its founder, Adolfo, has spent years working shifts in hospitality and services in Lima. Every week the schedule changes, arriving as a photo or a paper taped to the wall, and overtime ends up written down anywhere: on a phone, in a notebook, or only in memory.
historia.p2: From there came the question: why should keeping track of your own work be this complicated? Llankia is the answer: an app made by someone who lives those shifts, for the thousands of people who live them every day.

sobreNosotros.notaLegal: Llankia is a personal hour-tracking tool. Overtime calculations are indicative and depend on each user's settings and employment contract. They do not constitute legal or labor advice.

privacidad.intro: Llankia is an app for logging work hours and overtime. This policy explains what data we collect, what we use it for, who we share it with, and how you can control it. We wrote it to actually be understood, not to fill space.
privacidad.s1cuerpo: Llankia is operated by its developer, reachable at <email></email>. Any question about your data or this policy can be sent there.
privacidad.s2p1: From your account: name, email address, and profile photo, which we get from Google when you sign in.
privacidad.s2p2: From your profile: birthdate (optional, only to greet you on your birthday), hourly rate, currency, timezone, language, and hour format you choose.
privacidad.s2p3: From your work hours: the shifts you log (date, schedule, type, notes) and, if you upload a photo or text of your schedule for the AI to read, that photo or text and the shifts that result from reading it.
privacidad.s2p4: From Google Calendar: if you connect your account, we store an encrypted access token to create and update events on your calendar with your shifts. We don't read the rest of your calendar.
privacidad.s2p5: From teams: if you manage or belong to a team, the team's name, who's on it, and its members' hours (visible only to the team's admin).
privacidad.s3titulo: 3. What we use your data for
s3items: Calculating your worked hours, overtime, and estimated pay.
Reading a photo or text of your schedule and turning it into shifts (with AI).
Syncing your shifts to Google Calendar, if you turned that on.
Showing you reports and trends for your hours.
If you manage a team, showing you its members' hours and managing plan billing.
Sending you the welcome email when you sign up.
Notifying you in the app if the Llankia team replies to a message.
privacidad.s3final: We don't use your data for advertising, and we don't sell it to anyone.
privacidad.s4intro: We don't share your data with third parties for their own purposes. We do use these providers to make Llankia work, each one processing only what it needs for its job:
privacidad.s4supabase: Supabase — database, authentication, and photo storage.
privacidad.s4google: Google — sign-in and Google Calendar sync, based on what you authorize.
privacidad.s4anthropic: Anthropic (Claude) — reads the photo or text of your schedule to turn it into shifts. Those photos aren't used to train AI models.
privacidad.s5cuerpo: Llankia's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the <enlace>Google API Services User Data Policy</enlace>, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacidad.s6cuerpo: Photos you upload to log your schedule are stored in private storage: only you can see them. They're used solely so the AI can read your schedule; you can delete them whenever you want.
privacidad.s7titulo: 7. How long we keep your data
privacidad.s7cuerpo: We keep your data while your account is active. If you want to delete your account and all your information, write to us at <email></email> and we'll do it within a reasonable time. We're working on letting you do this yourself from the app.
privacidad.s8cuerpo: Each person can only see and change their own data (shifts, photos, profile); a team admin only sees their team's data. This is enforced directly in the database, not just by hiding buttons on screen. Your Google Calendar token is stored encrypted.
privacidad.s9cuerpo: You can ask us to access, correct, or delete your data at any time by writing to <email></email>. You can also disconnect Google Calendar from the Dashboard whenever you want.
privacidad.s10cuerpo: Llankia isn't directed at children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their data.
privacidad.s11cuerpo: If we make important changes to this policy, we'll announce it inside the app. The date above always shows the last update.
privacidad.s12cuerpo: Questions about your data or this policy? Write to us at <email></email>.

terminos.intro: These terms explain the rules for using Llankia. By creating an account or using the app, you accept them. If you have questions about anything, write to us before using the app.
terminos.s1cuerpo: Llankia is a tool for logging your work hours and overtime, reading your schedule from a photo or text, viewing reports of your hours, and —if you turn it on— syncing your shifts with Google Calendar. If you manage a team, it also lets you see its members' hours.
terminos.s2cuerpo: You sign in to Llankia with your Google account. You're responsible for keeping access to that account secure; any activity from your account is considered done by you. You must give us real information (your name, email) when using the app.
terminos.s3intro: By using Llankia, you agree to:
s3items: Use the app only to log your own work hours (or your team's, if you manage one).
Not upload photos, text, or content that isn't yours or that violates a third party's rights.
Not attempt to access other people's data without authorization.
Not use the app for illegal activities or to damage how it works.
terminos.s4cuerpo: Llankia is a personal hour-tracking tool. Overtime calculations are indicative and depend on the settings each user chooses and their employment contract. They don't constitute legal or labor advice. If you have questions about your labor rights, consult a professional or your country's labor authority.
terminos.s5cuerpo: Photos, text, and data you upload remain yours. You give us permission to process them (for example, sending your schedule photo to our AI provider to read it) solely to provide you the Llankia service, as described in the <enlace>privacy policy</enlace>.
terminos.s6cuerpo: If you create or manage a team, you can see its members' hours and invite or remove people. You're responsible for having the consent of those people to manage their information within Llankia.
terminos.s7cuerpo: Llankia has a free personal plan. The team management plan is under construction: for now, any charge inside the app is simulated and doesn't represent a real transaction. When billing becomes real, these terms will be updated and we'll let you know before it's turned on.
terminos.s8cuerpo: If you connect Google Calendar, that service has its own terms, independent of ours. We're not responsible for how those external services work.
terminos.s9cuerpo: The name "Llankia", the logo, the design, and the application's code are the property of its developer. You may not copy, resell, or distribute the app without permission.
terminos.s10cuerpo: You can stop using Llankia whenever you want. To delete your account and your data, write to us at <email></email>. We may also suspend or close an account if we detect misuse of the app.
terminos.s11cuerpo: Llankia is still under active development. We do our best to make it work well, but we offer it "as is", without guaranteeing it's free of errors at all times. We're not liable for losses resulting from the app malfunctioning, beyond what the law requires.
terminos.s12cuerpo: If we make important changes to these terms, we'll announce it inside the app. The date above always shows the last update.
terminos.s13cuerpo: Llankia is developed in Lima, Peru, and these terms are interpreted under Peruvian law.
terminos.s14cuerpo: Questions about these terms? Write to us at <email></email>.
